synthesis:draft.headline: As of 2026-08-05T21:00:00Z (2026-08-06 07:00 AEST) the provably-public TAS1 POE50 forecast for 2026-08-06 07:30 AEST was 1377.0 MW, and measured operational demand for the forecast target half‑hours was not provably public at that as_of.
summary: A public forecast run available at the as_of time (PUBLIC_FORECAST_OPERATIONAL_DEMAND_HH_202608060430_20260806040126) gave POE50 = 1377.0 MW for target_end_local "2026-08-06 07:30 AEST (UTC+1000)" [ev0505].

The same run gave POE50 = 1422.0 MW for target_end_local "2026-08-06 08:00 AEST (UTC+1000)" [ev0508] and POE50 = 1414.0 MW for target_end_local "2026-08-06 08:30 AEST (UTC+1000)" [ev0511]; it gave POE50 = 1417.0 MW for target_end_local "2026-08-06 19:00 AEST (UTC+1000)" [ev0574].

An earlier public run (PUBLIC_FORECAST_OPERATIONAL_DEMAND_HH_202608040130_20260804010137) had different POE50 values for the same target intervals, for example 1439.0 MW at "2026-08-06 07:30 AEST (UTC+1000)" [ev0001], 1481.0 MW at "2026-08-06 08:00 AEST (UTC+1000)" [ev0004] and 1424.0 MW at "2026-08-06 19:00 AEST (UTC+1000)" [ev0070].

For the provided event peak half-hour (interval end 2026-08-06T03:00:00Z / "2026-08-06 13:00 AEST (UTC+1000)") the run available at the as_of time had POE50 = 1084.0 MW [ev0538], while an earlier run had POE50 = 1160.0 MW for that interval [ev0034].

Measured operational demand provably public by the as_of time only extended to interval_end_local "2026-08-06 04:00 AEST (UTC+1000)" (interval_end_utc "2026-08-05T18:00:00Z") with operational_demand_mw = 1053.0 MW [ev0582]; measured values for the forecast target half‑hours were not provably public, so forecast-versus-actual alignment / errors could not be computed.
